name: CareCompanion
tagline: Medication reminders for elderly people and their families.
summary: A care and medication-reminder app that aims to help elderly people and their families keep to medication schedules.
problem: Keeping to a medication schedule is hard, for the person taking the medicine and for the family who worry about it. CareCompanion aims to help both sides keep to the schedule.

features.title: Medication reminders
features.text: Reminders for medication schedules (details to confirm).

howItWorks.text: Architecture details are still to be confirmed.

notice: CareCompanion is a prototype and a project in development. It is not a medical device, it gives no medical advice, and it uses no real patient data.
